description:
the same as scen7-h, but with burned area and fire emissions fixed at their 2001–2020 average. It requires burned area to be prescribed as an input field using each model’s own 2001–2020 average derived from its historical simulations, and in models without interactive fire emission modules, fire emissions in the 2022–2060 input
files must likewise be replaced with the 2001–2020 average.
